'''Sera Fray''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
She, under the orders of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ouzal]], tried to duplicate the informations contained in a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] into the brain of two Republic prisoners, [[Felix Iresso]] and [[Milo Pellam]], captured on [[Althir III]]. The experiment was a success with Iresso, locking away in a corner of his mind a library of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] knowledge. However, the experiment was unsuccessful with Pellam, driving him mad. Both were freed some time later.

Years later, Fray had escaped the Empire and had gone into hiding. Iresso, while working with the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attempted to look for her after Pellam became destructive and destroyed a starship belonging to a gangster, thinking it contained Sera Fray. This search led to her revealing herself to Iresso to explain the circumstances behind the experiment as well as to ask Iresso to remove her image from the Republic database, as it endangered her.

{{GameLS}}
Following the Barsen'thor's advice, Felix Iresso erased her from the Republic database stopped searching for her, ensuring her safety.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sera Fray first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]], as a non-playable character that's part of Felix Iresso's companion quest, available to [[Jedi Consular]]s.

The player has the option to advice Felix into erasing her from the Republic databases for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] points, or to endanger her in revenge for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points.
